description: Tell RankParse a campaign's emails are ready. It returns status ready_for_review with a review_url (the campaign page): the user reviews and approves each email there, and nothing is sent until they do. Only if the user turned on "Let Claude send without review" in RankParse does it queue the emails directly (queued/suppressed counts). Safe to call again; it never re-sends. When it returns ready_for_review, tell the user the emails are ready to review in RankParse and show them the review_url. If status is approved, it is already approved; do not launch again. If it returns queued/suppressed counts instead of ready_for_review, the emails are being sent now, so only call it after the user has seen the drafted emails and explicitly approved sending.
name: outreach_launch_campaign
